hook: Wrestling a glove on before every single shot.
beats: Mulligan: Can't swing without my glove.
Birdie: It's on the wrong hand.
setting: On the fairway, short grass and a flag in the distance behind them.
action: Mulligan tugs a tiny glove with his teeth and his whole arm, finally pulling his hat down over his face instead; Birdie stares.
sound: birdsong, a Velcro rip, a muffled grunt, a giggle
judge: Wrong-hand glove plus 'Lefty' is a tidy little turn.
